allocation_method.legacy_population_method: For every group except the last: int(num_envs * fraction); assign all remaining population to the last group.
allocation_method.remainder_bias: All truncation remainder accumulates in the final group. In recovery/terrain/jump/stepjump this is reverse yaw at sampled height; in speed it is height_scan.
allocation_method.height_transition_note: Cross-height motion groups have start_at_target_fraction=0.5; the remaining resets begin at nominal height and transition over 4 seconds.

corrected_stepjump_interpretation.sampling_applies_to: jump and running_jump groups without explicit request_events or command_sequence
corrected_stepjump_interpretation.future_rehearsal_clock_concern: Old flat-jump rehearsal currently follows the new stepjump domain actor clock. A future frozen revision should explicitly choose a stable inherited/fixed rehearsal distribution instead of silently restarting prior-skill difficulty.

future_recommendation_not_deployed.rationale: A terrain child initialized from speed can rehearse learned speed weights. Keeping terrain parent=flat while adding speed samples would require relearning speed within terrain, not preserving its latest candidate weights.
future_recommendation_not_deployed.training_method: Persistent simultaneous on-policy task, terrain and command families using fresh rollouts; no off-policy replay buffer or extra policy network is required.

family_distribution_design.reason: Recursive scaling causes the original flat pool to shrink geometrically across domains.
family_distribution_design.integer_allocation_recommendation: Allocate pool totals and family counts explicitly, then apportion remaining integers fairly instead of assigning all truncation remainder to the final reverse-yaw group.
